label: ISAAC SIM / FRANKA EMIKA PANDA
detail: placements are executed by the selected manipulator in NVIDIA Isaac Sim; the release is physical and PhysX settles the item under gravity and contact

robot.notes: Retained as the validated simulation and regression backend. WISEPACK has no physical Panda; this profile exists so that introducing a second robot can be shown not to have broken the first.

visualization.message: Isaac Sim is running headless with WebRTC streaming disabled (set WISEPACK_ISAAC_STREAMING=1 to enable it)

camera_to_workarea.notes: Fixed top-down mount assumed for the demonstrator. Height taken from one depth-plane fit on the bench, not from a calibration procedure. Replace with a measured_calibration entry when one exists; do not edit this one.

workarea_to_table.notes: Work-area origin placed in front of the robot by choice, not by measurement. The robot base itself is the `table` frame origin (0, 0, 0) and the table height is the selected robot layout's table_top_z_m; both are stated in wisepack_core.isaac_transform.SceneLayout and are not duplicated here.

camera.mount: fixed, above the work area, optical axis pointing down at the table
camera.note: The camera pose is the inverse of the first transform above. It is drawn in the Isaac scene as a frame marker so a wrong assumption is visible.

table_to_world.note: millimetres to metres; axes parallel; from the selected robot's SceneLayout
